items.title: Two boys rescued from Venezuela earthquake rubble after days of being trapped
items.description: Rescuers spent six hours carefully digging to reach one of the boys, as many residents continue searching through the rubble by hand, still waiting for heavy machinery to arrive.

items.title: In Caracas, this feels like the hardest moment in Venezuela's modern history
items.description: Rescue teams are working ceaselessly to reach those trapped under rubble. But as hope fades, anger is growing.

items.title: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
items.description: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

items.title: Eleven killed after plane carrying skydivers crashes in eastern France
items.description: The pilot and 10 passengers - including five first-time parachutists - died in the incident, local officials said.

items.title: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
items.description: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.

items.title: Australian man charged with murder after dead girl found in suitcase in Thailand
items.description: The 17-year-old's body was found discarded near a railway track on Saturday, police say.

items.title: Fourteen killed in Saudi Arabia helicopter crash
items.description: The aircraft belonged to state oil giant Aramco and the cause of the crash is being investigated.

items.title: Three firefighters die battling huge wildfires on Colorado-Utah border
items.description: A number of blazes have been raging across Utah and Colorado, leading both governors to declare states of emergency.

items.title: Uganda's leading media outlets shut down by army chief
items.description: NTV and Daily Monitor say their offices in the capital are under "military siege".

items.title: 117 dead dogs found at California 'no-kill' animal rescue - many with gunshot wounds
items.description: Hundreds more animals are still missing from the California facility as investigators continue excavating the grounds.

items.title: Australia to double maximum penalty for platforms in breach of social media ban
items.description: Children under the age of 16 have been prevented from 10 key social media platforms in Australia since December 2025.

items.title: Trump's face is added to select US passports for America's 250th birthday
items.description: The commemorative special edition passports will be available on 6 July, and can only be applied for in person
